# Nines Media

## What we are
Nines Media is a full-service digital marketing and creative agency based in Johannesburg, South Africa. We are a certified Google Partner and certified Meta Business Partner.

## What we do
- Google Ads management (Search, Display, Shopping, YouTube, Performance Max)
- Meta & Facebook advertising (Facebook, Instagram, Advantage+)
- Social media management (strategy, content creation, community management)
- Branding & identity (logo design, brand systems, brand guidelines)
- Web development (conversion-focused websites)
- AI-powered marketing and automation

## Who we serve
We work with businesses across South Africa — Johannesburg, Sandton, Fourways, Pretoria, Cape Town — and with international clients in Los Angeles (USA), London (UK), Australia, and New Zealand.
